title: Fixed Hooded Sling and Four Wheel Stroller
description: One newly authored complete static hooded-stroller appearance in an empty fixed display pose. Two continuous front-to-rear push side tubes and separate trailing legs support four full annular wheels in actual open forks, a shared rear pushbar and a complete continuous calf-seat-back sling. Two raised side bolsters border the sling. A full thick curved canopy forms a genuine open front underside and is rooted by two complete curved side ribs and rear stays. One low empty basket with its floor and walls sits within dedicated lower rails and crosssupports. This is not the manual wheelchair with its large handrims removed or the rollator with a differently coloured seat; all numerical geometry is new and no old component is imported. Three opaque materials, one prop zero scenes. Fixed visual art only: no child or occupant, textile simulation, restraint system, steering, rolling, folding path, seating or age suitability, human fit, loading, stability, manufacture, transport or product safety certification. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
